notes.title: Full version of Lesson Learned coming in May
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35377707/f430b8fe4c6bbd6bc98de34971ea0db46baab19d.png

Great news for every fan of tower defense games! The full version of Lesson Learned will be available on May 29, 2024, on Steam and Xbox!

Watch the teaser announcing the date of Lesson Learned:

https://youtu.be/RC2FGmXwU6E
In this hilarious tower defense game, Frank and a campaign led through different historical eras await you. Defend your mobile base with a succession of defense towers and distribute tasks among the minions - Frank's classmates.

You can play Lesson Learned in solo or cooperative mode. Invite friends and try your hand at split-screen campaign mode.

Play the free prologue Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth, which is now available. In it, you will learn the necessary mechanics and face the bloody Countess Elizabeth Batory. Also add Lesson Learned to your wishlist so you don't miss the release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1563870/Lesson_Learned/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2252360/Lesson_Learned_Cult_of_the_Elizabeth/

Gaming Factory

notes.title: 24h until release!
notes.notes:
Dear ZooKeepers!

There are only 24 hours left until ZooKeeper's premiere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/8e06fc7c459813554501e60086f1ac3b6bf52ee9.png

The game launches on the 18th of August, 18:00 CEST / 9:00 AM PDT!

On this occasion, we went to the mini zoo to see how real animals react to the news of the upcoming launch of ZooKeeper.

https://i.imgur.com/1lJh2J1.gif
Raccoons already seem bored with waiting. Fun Fact: Raccoons are omnivores and opportunistic eaters, which means they feed on whatever is most convenient. They are also adept scavengers. They rummage through garbage cans and compost piles and steal pet food that is left outside overnight.

https://i.imgur.com/ghI5OP0.gif
The camel is taking it easy. Fun Fact: A camel can last about 2 weeks without drinking, and a thirsty adult camel can drink up to 120 liters of water at a time.

https://i.imgur.com/6vkB0ut.gif
What animals will you find in ZooKeeper? Here you can see just a few of them. There is plenty more of them in the game, but we don't want to spoil everything for you.

Remember to take part in our Community Challenge!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/e96d8ddf8f11440155bb8f2a1940838dec73ec44.png

Follow us to have a chance to win Steam keys to Bakery Simulator, Castle Flipper, and Train Station Renovation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34740129/f3970aa12831f8120a099837330625c35e257809.gif

The whole giveaway will be performed on our discord, where you can speak with devs and other players, so join us now! Gaming Factory's Discord

If you still need more, be sure to follow our social channels where you will find more content from ZooKeeper!

Create the Zoo of your childhood dreams!

Best Regards,
ZooKeeper Team.
